author: GameTrailers
description:
It's time to visit a galaxy far, far, away...and do some cleaning. Watch the PowerWash Simulator 2 Star Wars pack launch trailer for this DLC, which takes you into the Star Wars universe. The Star Wars pack features the ability to restore memorable locations and vehicles, and this DLC pack for PowerWash Simulator 2 is inspired by iconic moments from the original Star Wars trilogy. The PowerWash Simulator 2 Star Wars pack features six new playable jobs, including Lars’ Homestead,, Mos Eisley Cantina, Blizzard 3 AT-AT, Executor Super Star Destoryer Bridge, Red 2 X-Wing Fighter, and the Millennium Fighter. 

The Star Wars Pack for PowerWash Simulator 2 is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC.
title: PowerWash Simulator 2 - Official Star Wars Pack Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
'Two worlds, one fateful encounter.' Watch the Star Ocean The Second Story R trailer for another look at this RPG remake. The second installment in the Star Ocean series returns as Star Ocean The Second Story R, featuring a 2.5D aesthetic that fuses 2D pixel characters and 3D environments. Star Ocean The Second Story R also features new battle mechanics, full Japanese and English voice-overs, original and re-arranged music, fast-travel, and more. 

In Star Ocean The Second Story R, Space Date 366 - A Federation officer finds himself transported to a mystical planet. While searching for a way home, an encounter with a young girl draws him into a quest to save her people, just as an ancient prophecy foretold. Choose your path and witness an awakened destiny. 

Star Ocean The Second Story R is now available on Nintendo Switch 2. It is also available on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), and PC.
title: Star Ocean The Second Story R - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer

description:

Wishlist it and/or try the demo on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1636620/Cognition_Method/

description: Farlands leaves early access, and version 1.0 is available now on Steam. Watch the Farlands launch trailer for this farming sim game. An agrarian rock at the edge of the galaxy that, for some reason, was practically being given away for free. So the time has come to leave your hectic, stressful life in an overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.
title: Farlands - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Langrisser: Sea of Sword teaser trailer for the next fantasy tactical RPG in the Langrisser series. Langrisser: Sea of Sword is developed by BlackJack Studio (the original team behind Langrisser Mobile), with a new score by composer Yasunori Nishiki. 

In Langrisser: Sea of Sword, you become the Nameless, a figure searching for lost memories from the shadows. Alongside a mysterious white-haired girl, you rise from mire and mist into a world of shifting loyalties, impossible choices, and nations standing on the brink. Across the mist-shrouded sea, hidden currents begin to stir, and a new saga unfolds.

Classic strategy is the key to breaking through the chaos. Amid the flames of war, every move, every formation, and every decision will shape the course of fate.

Langrisser: Sea of Sword is set for a global multi-platform release across iOS, Android, PC, Steam, and more. Global pre-registration is now open across multiple platforms.
title: Langrisser: Sea of Sword - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the latest BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X trailer for the roguelite action game to see what's coming with the content update, along with a Nintendo Switch 2 announcement. A content update will also be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and Xbox Series X/S on August 13, bringing the new playable character Platinum, an upgraded Training Space, new branching route options for each run, and more.
title: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X - Official Nintendo Switch 2 and Content Update Announce Trailer
